question: Does candidate-specific query scoring need both inherited preferred-crossing prefixes and fixed-current-tree terminal semantics to measure physically attachable alternatives under the same256-expansion cap?
input: All3809 complete actual guided-search domains, actual queued seeds and full current trees from actual_search_tree_eltwise_dev_01, same RRG/budgets and static preferred-source adjacency. All observed, one seen circuit; not blind or independent circuit samples.
arms: P:existing targeted single-additional-preferred-cross query; only off-sink-layer queued seeds, graph walks may intersect retained tree
I:P plus sink-layer actual seeds whose source-to-seed current tree prefix already traverses a preferred crossing; direct no-new-cross continuation satisfies the candidate
L:P with fixed-tree terminal semantics: at any current-tree node, allow only a virtual goal if that node is an eligible actual queued seed, and never expand through another retained-tree node
IL:inherited-prefix goals plus fixed-tree terminal semantics
unit_validation: Independent forward layered-graph Floyd on randomized directed graphs and retained-tree/queued-seed masks, including no eligible source, zero cycles, inherited preference, intersection and work/storage limits. A missing lower certificate on memory loss must remain missing.
actual_validation: Audit all returned physical edges, BB, inherited-prefix/crossing identity, actual native float seed Tdel and (for L/IL) no other current-tree intersection. Independently verify any returned lower certificate by Dijkstra through every state cheaper than that claimed frontier; combine with the physical witness to verify exactness when reported. This need not exhaust the full optimum for an unknown interval. Normalize old P outputs against existing10focus Pi results where domains match.
qualification: Only the planner-query graph is restricted by fixed-tree semantics; native routing branches/congestion/STA are not modified. Raw graph walks may be useful if existing branches are replaced, but they are not guaranteed extensions of the fixed retained tree. Both raw and constrained query populations/statuses remain visible. Comparing UBs is not a confidence certificate; an offline improvement does not establish effectiveness of a native routing policy; paired native validation remains necessary.
